statement.p: a) Compute each of the following expressions and interpret each as an average rate of change:

b) Based on the graph sketched below, match each of your answers in (i) - (iii) with one of the lines labeled A - F. Type the corresponding letter of the line segment next to the appropriate formula. Clearly not all letters will be used.

image.shortdescription: The graph of a function with lines shown between various points on and off the graph.

description.p: Line A is horizontal from the point (4,f(4)) to the y axis.
Line B goes from the point (0,f(0)) to (6,f(6)).
Line C goes from the point (4,f(4)) to the point (6,f(6)).
Line D goes from the point (0,f(0)) to (4,f(4)).
Line E goes from the point (0,0) to (4,f(4)).
Line F is vertical from the point (4,f(4)) to the x axis.

solution.p: b) The formulas in parts (i), (ii), and (iii) represent the average rate of change of f(x) over the intervals 0 \leq x \leq 4 , 4 \leq x \leq 6 , and 0 \leq x \leq 6 respectively. Thus line segment D connecting the points (0, 36 ) and ( 4, 20 ) illustrates formula (i), line segment C connecting the points ( 4, 20 ) and ( 6, 0 ) illustrates formula (ii), and line segment B connecting the points (0, 36 ) and ( 6, 0 ) illustrates formula (iii).
